This is my main maize plot and I need it to feed my family and maybe sell some at market. Here in Ruvuma the rains are usually good so maize does well, and many of my neighbors buy a bag of fertilizer when they can afford it. I will try to buy one bag of CAN to topdress, and I will also carry manure from my cattle boma to the plot before planting. For seed I will buy improved maize from the agro-dealer since the local seed does not yield well anymore, but I cannot afford sprays so I will just weed by hand with my family and hire a few people for the first weeding.
